spiritgiven.comments:
Very nice game, few to no calls, solved quickely despite language barrier.
Joyful people, high fiving each points
Thanks for the game :)
Great spirit, calm communication despites a lot of calls
Really fun and smily guys, calm despite a hard contact from our side
From far one of the most spirited game we ever played against a GB side, nice and funny boy, a lot of smile and fast communication on the few calls, very fair resolutions

The spirit note does not match what we said in the spirit huddle, we’re sorry for that, our spirit captain did not recap what we said between us.
What we need to remember of this game is that the communication was too long and colombians heated up early on each calls.
Other wise a really nice game on the side lines and little to no body contact throughout each lay out
Really nice game, fast communication throughout each call, very spirited outcome each time

Too many calls throughout the game, it’s okay to make calls you told us you were consistent with calling throughout the game, but some calls we’re unnecessary. The game flow was really jerky, not fun to watch and play. The communications were too long and spirit captains and game advisors met a lot of times and it didn’t seem to affect the way Belgium approached spirit. Unspirited reaction to the only call we made in this game.
Both team have a lot to learn from this game

Some heat on the calls but each one was resolved quickly with a fair mind, opinions were heard and took in consideration.
Thanks Canada for this game and good luck for the 3rd place!

spiritreceived.comments: Overall a very well spirited game with good communication between spirit captains and a well fought game with high intensity. Thank you France!

French player called a incorrect foul and denied wrongdoing, not much listening.

Contact was deliberate and much more than agreed.
Some fouls and some grabbing on defense. Everything else was good.

The contact was very frequent and dangerous. We told you guys about it but we felt only a minor change. This resolved in us calling quite a few fouls upon which you almost always contested. The least spirited part of our game we feel was the sideline and the chants ("ils sont nuls") that you shouted which were often disrespectful and that do not belong in Ultimate Frisbee. The shocking and disappointing part is that it wasn't only your supporters or some individuals but the whole team.
a lot of calls were made that did not effect overall play and wasted time
